name: faq-grid
title: FAQ Grid
description: Every question and answer on the page at once in a numbered grid, revealed in a soft stagger. No clicks needed.

props.name: title
props.description: The section headline. Labels the section for assistive tech.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; question: ReactNode; answer: ReactNode }[]
props.description: Questions and answers. Every answer stays visible.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds each answer takes to fade in.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
